guide_q: how does Bitcoin hash a public key with SHA256 and then with RIPEMD-160?
note: guide_q / agent / root: the questions the page test puts to the guide and to one agent, so that it can check that the guide hands over to the right one. The hash functions agent covers SHA256, RIPEMD-160 and HASH160, every one of which carries an executed example, so a follow-up asking for an example can be answered; it is not the largest agent (the segwit agent covers fourteen concepts and the legacy agent eleven), which the test uses elsewhere. The switches say what SEN0401 does not yet have, so that a check which needs it is listed as a skip instead of failing: corpus_kinds names the kinds of passage the agents search (there is no textbook or course ontology yet) and course_outcomes says that no course ontology with LO-n outcomes exists. code_layers is true because every worked example of this chapter is a Python expression, so the ontology graph can draw the syntax and behaviour links and the error conditions. The question bank of chapter 4 has an item for every concept, so bank_complete is not set to false.
